data.title: Notice of Adverse Benefit Determination
data.what_it_is: This is a denial of an MRI of your lower back. The plan says the request did not show six weeks of conservative treatment first, so it will not pay for the scan. You can appeal the decision.

key_points.text: The denial is for an MRI (CPT 72148). If you get the scan, the plan says you owe $1,925.00 of the $2,140.00 allowed amount.

citation.quote: The plan's allowed amount for CPT 72148 is $2,140.00, and the member cost share is $1,925.00.

key_points.text: You have the right to an internal appeal, and it must be received by January 31, 2027.

citation.quote: Your internal appeal must be received no later than January 31, 2027.

key_points.text: Include a letter from your doctor and treatment records that show at least six weeks of conservative care.

citation.quote: Clinical records that show at least six weeks of treatment, such as physical therapy notes, medication records, or office visit notes.

key_points.text: If waiting could seriously harm your health, your doctor can ask for an expedited appeal; the plan says it will respond within 72 hours.

citation.quote: If your doctor certifies that a delay could seriously jeopardize your health, you may request an expedited appeal by calling the number below.

data.next_action: Ask Dr. Ruiz for a letter and the last six months of treatment records, then mail or fax the appeal package before January 31, 2027.

deadlines.what: Internal appeal must be received by the plan
deadlines.consequence: If you miss it, you lose this internal appeal; ask the plan about external review options.
deadlines.action: Mail or fax the appeal package with your doctor's letter and treatment records.

citation.quote: Your internal appeal must be received no later than January 31, 2027.

deadlines.what: Expedited appeal, if your doctor certifies that a delay could seriously jeopardize your health
deadlines.consequence: The plan says it will respond within 72 hours if it accepts the expedited request.
deadlines.action: Call the plan and ask your doctor to document that the wait could harm your health.

citation.quote: If your doctor certifies that a delay could seriously jeopardize your health, you may request an expedited appeal by calling the number below.

data.note: The notice says the plan decides internal appeals within 30 days; the dates above are filing dates, not decision dates.

data.answer: You need to file an internal appeal with the plan before January 31, 2027. Send a signed letter explaining why the MRI is medically necessary, a letter from Dr. Ruiz, and treatment records showing at least six weeks of conservative care. If waiting could seriously harm your health, ask your doctor to request an expedited appeal.

citations.quote: Your internal appeal must be received no later than January 31, 2027.
Clinical records that show at least six weeks of treatment, such as physical therapy notes, medication records, or office visit notes.
If your doctor certifies that a delay could seriously jeopardize your health, you may request an expedited appeal by calling the number below.

data.missing_info: The notice does not say whether Dr. Ruiz has already sent records to the plan. Confirm that with the doctor's office.

data.to: Appeals Department, Hudson Valley Health Plan
data.subject: Internal appeal of adverse benefit determination - MRI CPT 72148 - Member ID HV-4471-2290
data.body:
To: Appeals Department, Hudson Valley Health Plan

Re: Internal appeal - Notice of Adverse Benefit Determination dated December 2, 2026
Member: Marisol Alvarez
Member ID: HV-4471-2290
Case: A-771903

Dear Appeals Department,

I am writing to appeal your decision to deny coverage for an MRI of the lumbar spine (CPT 72148), ordered by Dr. Elena Ruiz. The notice states that the request did not document six weeks of conservative treatment.

I am enclosing a letter from Dr. Ruiz describing my symptoms and the conservative treatments I have tried, along with clinical records that show at least six weeks of treatment. Please reconsider the denial based on this information.

If you need anything else to complete the review, please contact me at [Phone] or [Email]. Please send your written decision to the address above.

Sincerely,
Marisol Alvarez
[Address]
[Phone]
checklist: A signed letter explaining why the MRI is medically necessary
A letter from Dr. Ruiz describing symptoms and treatments tried
Clinical records showing at least six weeks of conservative treatment
The name and phone number of the ordering provider
A copy of the denial notice and this appeal letter for your records
data.send_via: Mail: Hudson Valley Health Plan, Appeals Department, P.O. Box 9127, Albany, NY 12212. Phone: 1-800-555-0142 (TTY 711).
data.caution: This is not medical or legal advice. Confirm the deadline, address and member ID on your notice before sending, and keep a copy of everything you mail.

citations.quote: We have denied the requested service as not medically necessary under plan policy RAD-204 (Advanced Imaging Review).
Mail your appeal to Hudson Valley Health Plan, Appeals Department, P.O. Box 9127, Albany, NY 12212.
A letter from the ordering provider describing your symptoms and the conservative treatments you have tried.

data.title: SNAP Recertification Notice
data.what_it_is: This notice says your household must recertify for SNAP to keep receiving benefits after your certification period ends on January 31, 2027. You have a phone interview and must send the form and required documents by January 15, 2027.

key_points.text: A telephone interview is scheduled for January 8, 2027 at 10:30 a.m.

citation.quote: A telephone interview is scheduled for January 8, 2027 at 10:30 a.m.

key_points.text: Your completed form and all required documents must be submitted by January 15, 2027.

citation.quote: Your completed recertification form and all required documents must be submitted by January 15, 2027.

key_points.text: You will need recent pay stubs, proof of rent, a utility bill, and photo ID for the head of household.

citation.quote: Proof of income for the last 30 days, such as pay stubs for the last four weeks or a letter from your employer.

key_points.text: If you miss the deadline, your benefits will stop on February 1, 2027.

citation.quote: If you miss this deadline, your benefits will stop on February 1, 2027.

data.next_action: Gather the signed form, four weeks of pay stubs, rent proof, utility bill and photo ID, then submit them by January 15, 2027. Take the January 8 interview call.

data.title: Request for Evidence
data.what_it_is: This is a Request for Evidence in your family petition. It is not a denial. The agency wants at least three types of proof that you have lived together as a married couple, and your response must be received by February 26, 2027.

key_points.text: This notice is a request for more evidence, not a denial of the petition.

citation.quote: This request for evidence asks for additional documents before we can decide your case. This is not a denial.

key_points.text: You need at least three of the listed evidence types to show you have lived together as a married couple.

citation.quote: We need at least three of the following:

key_points.text: Your response must be received by February 26, 2027.

citation.quote: Your response must be received by February 26, 2027.

key_points.text: If the agency does not receive a response, it may decide using only the evidence already in the file.

citation.quote: If we do not receive your response by that date, we may decide your case using the evidence we already have.

data.next_action: Gather at least three kinds of joint evidence, fill in the cover sheet, write the receipt number on every page, and send one complete package before February 26, 2027. Keep a copy.

deadlines.what: Response to the Request for Evidence must be received by the agency
deadlines.consequence: The agency may decide the case using only the evidence it already has.
deadlines.action: Send one complete response package with the cover sheet and the receipt number on every page.

citation.quote: Your response must be received by February 26, 2027.

data.note: The notice says this is a request for evidence, not a denial. If you need help, it suggests contacting a legal services organization or an accredited representative.

data.answer: The agency needs at least three types of evidence that you have lived together as a married couple, such as a joint lease or deed, joint bank statements, insurance documents, photos with family, or signed affidavits. Send one complete package with the cover sheet, and make sure it is received by February 26, 2027.

citations.quote: We need at least three of the following:
A joint lease, mortgage statement, or property deed.
Your response must be received by February 26, 2027.

data.missing_info: The notice does not say how many photos or affidavits are enough. Include a short cover letter listing every document you send.
